original_evidence.text: | Dolphin (file manager) | invent.kde.org/system/dolphin (HEAD ee7e50f) | Qt/KF6 | N (no self-updater) | N (manual — user clicks "Download New Services" in Settings) | **Y** — via the KNewStuff "Service Menus" content channel, downloaded archives are executed as installer scripts | HTTPS (`ProvidersUrl=https://autoconfig.kde.org/ocs/providers.xml`, actual payload host is provider-controlled/dynamic) | N | N (framework never checks the `checksum`/`signature` XML fields it parses) | none — `signature` field is parsed from the OCS feed but never validated against any GPG key anywhere in the framework | `dolphin/src/settings/contextmenu/servicemenu.knsrc` — `ContentWarning=Executables`, `InstallationCommand=servicemenuinstaller install %f`, `TargetDir=servicemenu-download`, `Uncompress=never`. `dolphin/src/settings/contextmenu/servicemenuinstaller/servicemenuinstaller.cpp:259-283` (`runScriptVariants`/`runScriptOnce`) chmod's the downloaded file `+x` (line 262) and runs it via `QProcess::start` (lines 219-247), searching for `install-it.sh`, `install.sh`, `installKDE4.sh`, etc. inside the downloaded archive (lines 330-364). This is a genuine download-and-execute path for arbitrary third-party service-menu packages from the KDE Store. |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: N (manual — user clicks "Download New Services" in Settings)

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: **Y** — via the KNewStuff "Service Menus" content channel, downloaded archives are executed as installer scripts

fields.label: transport
fields.value: HTTPS (`ProvidersUrl=https://autoconfig.kde.org/ocs/providers.xml`, actual payload host is provider-controlled/dynamic)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: N (framework never checks the `checksum`/`signature` XML fields it parses)

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: none — `signature` field is parsed from the OCS feed but never validated against any GPG key anywhere in the framework

fields.label: evidence
fields.value: `dolphin/src/settings/contextmenu/servicemenu.knsrc` — `ContentWarning=Executables`, `InstallationCommand=servicemenuinstaller install %f`, `TargetDir=servicemenu-download`, `Uncompress=never`. `dolphin/src/settings/contextmenu/servicemenuinstaller/servicemenuinstaller.cpp:259-283` (`runScriptVariants`/`runScriptOnce`) chmod's the downloaded file `+x` (line 262) and runs it via `QProcess::start` (lines 219-247), searching for `install-it.sh`, `install.sh`, `installKDE4.sh`, etc. inside the downloaded archive (lines 330-364). This is a genuine download-and-execute path for arbitrary third-party service-menu packages from the KDE Store.
